svg.title: Ratchet, measured
svg.desc: Feature 1, continued: Ratchet, measured (22–24 Oct 2026). Strict scoring, on exams the adapters never saw. Fig. 4, exam results: text-to-sql, exam 1, 172 questions: 12.8% untrained, 39.0% with the adapter; tool calling, hard exam, 150 questions: 62.7% untrained, 90.7% with the adapter. About $17 on record to teach the two text-to-SQL adapters. 95% precision at the golden gate before a new adapter ships. LoRA adapter you own with each teacher’s license logged. Link: ratchet.dualmindlab.tech.
